title: HECM Line of Credit Draw Limits and Disbursement Methods
content:
Which Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) payout plans carry a line of credit the borrower may draw on after closing, and the amounts, channels, methods and timings that apply to those draws, plan by plan.

| | HECM Line of Credit | HECM Tenure Payment Plan | HECM Term Payment Plan | HECM Modified Tenure Plan | HECM Modified Term Plan | HECM Fixed-Rate Single Disbursement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Line-of-credit draws after closing | yes | no | no | yes | yes | no |
| Smallest draw disbursed (USD) | 500.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 500.00 | 500.00 | 0.00 |
| Disbursement of a complete draw request within (business days, Monday to Friday excluding federal holidays) | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 |
| Largest single draw accepted on a verified phone request (USD) | 15000.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 15000.00 | 15000.00 | 0.00 |
| Smallest draw that may be sent by wire (USD) | 5000.00 | 5000.00 | 5000.00 | 5000.00 | 5000.00 | 5000.00 |
| Disbursement methods a draw may use | ACH, wire, check | none | none | ACH, wire, check | ACH, wire, check | none |
| Calendar days after issue after which an uncashed draw or scheduled-payment check is voided | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 |
| A returned or voided draw credited back to the line and reversed from the balance | yes | no | no | yes | yes | no |

An amount of 0.00 marks a plan that has no draws. A draw larger than the phone figure needs a servicing-portal or signed written request; a draw smaller than the wire figure goes by ACH or check.

## Hypothetical illustrations

- On the HECM Line of Credit a phone request for 12000.00 is within the phone figure; a phone request for 18000.00 is not.
- A draw of 4000.00 is below the wire figure and so is not sent by wire; a draw of 5000.00 may be.
